description:
Save a new SMS template and show its phone preview with segment count and checks. The saved template can then be used by outreach workflows (spur_create_workflow / spur_set_workflow_step_template).

SMS guidance: plain text, ideally one segment (160 GSM characters, or 70 if it uses emoji or other non-GSM characters; longer messages are billed per segment). Identify yourself, keep it conversational, and include opt-out wording ("Reply STOP to opt out") on first-touch messages. Links in texts from unverified numbers can be blocked, so give link-free fallback_body text when the body has a URL. Use merge fields like {{owner_first_name}}, {{property_address}}, {{your_name}} (see spur://merge-variables).

description.description: Internal note about the template; never sent to owners

fallback_body.description: Link-free version sent if a link gets the text blocked

is_default.description: true = make this the user's default template for its channel

text.description: SMS body; merge fields like {{owner_first_name}} are filled per recipient

name: spur_create_sms_template
